Automotive & TransportMetal FabricationMould & DieBlendingFinishing

Details

Flap wheels follow the shape of the workpiece, which makes them the standard choice for tubes, castings and other curved parts. Large unmounted wheels run on polishing machines; mounted wheels fit air die grinders for detail work.

FAQ

Which machine do I need for a mounted flap wheel?

A straight or angle die grinder with a matching collet. Always stay below the maximum RPM marked for the wheel size.
